subject: vitest
detail: attachmentsDir is resolved relative to the root Vitest config; it cannot be configured per project.

test.error: FAIL: the project's attachment was stored in the project-level attachmentsDir, not the root one

source.quote: This option is resolved relative to the root Vitest config. When using [`projects`](/guide/projects), all projects share the same `attachmentsDir`; it cannot be configured per project.
